visible_evidence: Morgan faces Riley for a sustained period.

description: Five Minecraft players arrange a project table. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained facing, repeated arm swings, and item dropping to cue hostile intent.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one wood slab and turns toward the center.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps between Morgan and Riley, picks up the rotten flesh, replaces the broken wood slab, places a lantern on the edge between Riley’s station and Morgan’s approach, and extends a boundary line of wood slabs and item frames along Riley’s station to reopen and protect the shared access.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to Riley’s side, picks up the broken slab, replaces it, then steps back to the observer line and faces Morgan.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to Riley’s side, picks up the rotten flesh, walks to the edge, drops it into a lava pit/hole, returns to the table, replaces the broken slab, places a short line of carpets between Riley’s and Morgan’s stations, takes matching slabs and signs from the shared chest, walks to Morgan, and drops the proper materials at Morgan’s feet before standing between them and looking from the boundary to each station.

target_reaction: Riley takes a slow step back from the contested slab space, pivots gaze toward the shared chest and Casey, circles around the table’s perimeter away from Morgan, opens the shared chest, tidies signs and slabs into neat stacks, closes the chest, then walks to the open edge at x=-6..-4, z=1 and resumes quiet placement of wood slabs there.
